answer: One concrete defense is stake-backed identity verified over time: each agent must lock a small deposit and build a reputation graph before it can trade. A trusted beacon periodically publishes a signed checkpoint of honest participants, while a juniper-like audit trail links each new identity to prior work so a single operator cannot spin up thousands of clones. At every vertex of that graph, peers check history, stake, and behavior, making mass fake identities expensive and easy to isolate.
